newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-ORIOLES DAVIS NEEDS SURGERY; OUT EIGHT WEEKS.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-ORIOLES DAVIS NEEDS SURGERY; OUT EIGHT WEEKS.

text.p: The high-flying Baltimore Orioles announced Monday that three-time Golden Glove outfielder Eric Davis needs abdominal surgery and is expected to be sidelined for eight weeks.
He is hitting .302 with seven home runs and 21 RBI in 34 games this season for the American League East's first-place Orioles, who have the best record in the major leagues of 39-17.
Davis, 34, who has not played since May 25, will undergo a procedure called a laparotomy on Friday.
The often-injured Davis was forced out of a May 24 game against Cleveland with what was described as an abdominal pull before going 0-for-5 the following day in a 7-6 loss to the Indians.
